vendor_id: vendor_jumio
vendor_name: Jumio
vendor_type: identity_verification
retrieved_at: 2026-10-03

public_resources:
- https://documentation.jumio.ai/docs/references/capabilities/liveness
- https://www.jumio.com/products/liveness-detection/
- https://documentation.jumio.ai/
- https://github.com/Jumio/documentation

key_components:

liveness_detection:
  approach: Active and passive options
  active_liveness: Yes, users may be asked to blink, turn head, speak, or follow on-screen object
  passive_liveness: Yes, analyzes selfie/video for liveness signals without user action
  face_template: Optional FaceMap technology for face-based biometrics
  anti_spoofing: ISO/IEC 30107-3 Level 2 PAD conformance via iBeta lab testing
  detects: digital copy, photocopy, manipulated selfie
  outcome_types: Passed, Rejected, Warnings (quality issues, multiple faces)

document_verification:
  supported_types: Passports, driver's licenses, national IDs, government-issued IDs
  capture_method: Front and back photos via web client or SDK
  data_extraction: OCR-based
  security: TLS encryption for data transfer, API authentication via token/secret

device_and_session:
  integration_modes: Web SDK, native SDKs (iOS/Android), REST APIs
  workflow: Initialize session -> Capture ID -> Selfie/Liveness -> Decision
  real_time_feedback: Yes, guidance for better image capture
  webhooks: Available for session outcomes

fraud_controls:
  risk_based_decision: Yes, pass/warning/fail logic
  kuc_aml_support: Built-in KYC/AML compliance

compliance:
  standards: ISO/IEC 30107-3 Level 2 PAD
  use_cases: Financial onboarding, eKYC, AML, ongoing authentication

notes:
- Offers both active and passive liveness (Jumio is more flexible than Veriff's passive-only approach)
- Active challenge prompts (blink, head turn, speak) harder to spoof with static media
- Comprehensive documentation in GitHub and official portals
- No public disclosure of anti-spoofing robustness on degraded/compressed media
